title: Right derived inverse-unit compatibility with an injective-complex boundary
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with derived categories, A with enough injectives. Let v:A→B be additive. Let H be a short complex of bounded below integer-indexed cochain complexes of A, with every term of all three complexes injective. Assume its underlying sequence of complexes and its termwise v-image are short exact. Define d_H in D⁺(A) by lifting the canonical SES boundary after the quotient factorization at its endpoints. Define c_K: Rv(Q⁺K)→Q(vK) as the inverse right-derived unit at the homotopy class of K, followed by the quotient factorization. Then Rv(d_H) followed by the shift comparison and c_H1[1] equals c_H3 followed by the canonical boundary of the image SES. Neither single objects nor augmentation maps nor chosen injective resolutions occur in this assertion. The inverse unit is an inverse of an isomorphism and the lift through the full faithful inclusion is unique; both definitions contain real data, with no unproved existence choice.

proof.text: Use the simultaneous homotopy-boundary lift to choose f in K⁺(A) representing both canonical SES boundaries. Cancel the inclusion shift comparison and quotient-factorization comparison to identify ShiftedHom.map f Qh with boundedBelowSESBoundary.

Whisker rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit by the derived inclusion. Its endpoint components are isomorphisms on the injective complexes. Apply ShiftedHom.map_naturality, cancel and invert the endpoint units to obtain inverse-unit naturality for f. Expand composite shift comparisons and compose with the image quotient-factorization comparison. Substitute the two boundary identifications to obtain exactly the asserted equation.

theorem rightDerived_injectiveComplex_boundary
    (v : A ⥤ B) [v.Additive] (H : ShortComplex (CochainComplex.Plus A))
    [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (H.X₁.obj.X n)]
    [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (H.X₂.obj.X n)]
    [∀ n : ℤ, Injective (H.X₃.obj.X n)]
    (hH : (H.map (CochainComplex.plus A).ι).ShortExact)
    (hvH : ((H.map (CochainComplex.plus A).ι).map
      (v.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).ShortExact) :
    (v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).map
        (boundedBelowSESBoundary H hH) ≫
      ((v.rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.ι).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj H.X₁) ≫
      (boundedBelowInjectiveComparison v H.X₁)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
    boundedBelowInjectiveComparison v H.X₃ ≫ DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hvH
